lms_resources_youtube_check.name: lms_resources_youtube_check
lms_resources_youtube_check.value: ("lms_resources"."kind" = 'youtube' AND "lms_resources"."content_hash" IS NULL AND "lms_resources"."content_type" IS NULL AND "lms_resources"."file_size" IS NULL AND ("lms_resources"."youtube_video_id" IS NULL OR ((length("lms_resources"."youtube_video_id") = 11 AND "lms_resources"."youtube_video_id" NOT GLOB '*[^A-Za-z0-9_-]*') AND "lms_resources"."youtube_video_id" GLOB '*[A-Za-z0-9]*')) AND (NOT "lms_resources"."enabled" OR "lms_resources"."youtube_video_id" IS NOT NULL)) OR ("lms_resources"."kind" <> 'youtube' AND "lms_resources"."youtube_video_id" IS NULL)
